tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: List the hairstyles BaldFade can preview on a portrait photo (bald, buzz cut, fades, tapers), with a link to each style page. Read-only, no charge. Generating a preview is done on https://baldfade.net (single image 4.99 USD, or credits); this server does not upload photos or take payments.
